analog_notes: Analogs are selected from 15 years of ERA5 daily data within +/-45 calendar days.
Similarity uses standardized temperature, precipitation, wind, radiation, cloud and pressure; it is descriptive rather than predictive.

notes: Synoptic fields are model analyses from Open-Meteo Historical Forecast data.
Frames are sampled every 6 hours on a 1-degree Central European grid.
Vorticity, thermal advection and kinematic frontogenesis are finite-difference diagnostics derived on the reporting grid.
A true 2-PVU dynamical-tropopause surface is not exposed by the no-secret provider and is not approximated.
Standard anomalies use 30 same-calendar ERA5 periods from 1991-2020.
Full-record percentiles use 36 same-calendar periods from 1990-2025.
The recent-climate comparison uses 10 periods and remains separate from the WMO standard-normal window.
Rolling soil, VPD and ET0 fields use Open-Meteo Historical Weather best-match gridded data, not station measurements.
The 1991-2020 water-balance reference is fixed to ERA5; the rolling best-match series can use newer IFS and ERA5/ERA5-Land inputs.
Water balance is precipitation minus FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration and does not include runoff or irrigation.
Dry/wet context uses the 1991-2020 distribution of same-calendar water-balance windows.
PV yield models a south-facing 35-degree fixed array per installed kWp using plane-of-array irradiance and cell-temperature derating.
Wind output uses observed/modelled 100 m wind, moist-air density correction, and a generic 3/12/25 m/s cut-in/rated/cut-out power curve.
These are reference-system weather yields, not metered production or a forecast.

methodology.calculation: For each usable activity hour start at 100, subtract one matching band per rule, floor at zero and apply the smallest severity ceiling. Divide the sum by expected hours and round down. Unknown hours add no credit. At least 25% severe hours caps the window at 54; any hour capped at 29 caps the window at 79. Commute uses the worse of two journeys. Solar uses the separately stated season-relative radiation ratio.
methodology.calibration_status: provisional transparent heuristics; scenario-tested, not physiological validation
methodology.coverage_policy: Require at least 90% jointly valid expected slots per activity window; solar and PV daily totals require 100%. Withhold only affected results; never substitute missing or fallback evidence.
